title: Bitwise Models Solana's 2031 Valuation Around Tokenized Stock Trading
why_it_matters: The model makes tokenized equity trading a measurable driver of blockchain economics, while exposing how strongly projected network fees depend on adoption, competing chains and transaction throughput. These are scenarios, not investment targets or confirmed market outcomes.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Bitwise Models Solana's 2031 Valuation Around Tokenized Stock Trading

A November 16 Bitwise research paper models SOL at $1,100 in a bullish 2031 scenario versus $385 in its base case, assuming rapid growth in tokenized-equity trading and network capacity.
